chalisa.do1: Victory to Kālī, Mother of the world; victory to you who take away the mass of heaped-up sins. Dwell night and day in the bower of your servant's heart.
chalisa.do2: Victory to Kālikā, bearer of skulls, wearer of skeletons, giver of joy. Giver of boons, be gracious, deeming me your own servant.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Kālī, Kaṅkālī, wearer of skeletons; victory to Kapālinī, bearer of skulls, victory to Karālī, the terrible. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: You are the beloved of Śiva, Aparṇā, Ambā the Mother; victory to Kapardinī of the matted locks, victory to Jagadambā, Mother of the world. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You are Āryā, Halā, Ambikā, Māyā, Kātyāyanī, Umā, and she who gave birth to the world. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: You are Girijā, Gaurī, Durgā, Caṇḍī, Dākṣāyaṇī, Śāmbhavī and Pracaṇḍī, the fierce. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: You are Pārvatī, Maṅgalā, Bhavānī, creator of the universe, Satī and Mṛḍānī. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: You are Sarvamaṅgalā, daughter of the mountain, Haimavatī; the world bows to you in praise. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Victory to Brahmacāriṇī, Kālarātri; victory to Mahārātri, victory to Moharātri. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: You are the Trimūrti, the three gods in one, Rohiṇī, Kālikā, Kūṣmāṇḍā, Kārtikī and Caṇḍikā. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: You are Tārā, Bhuvaneśvarī, the peerless one; you yourself are Chinnamastā, pure and blessed. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You are Mother Dhūmāvatī and Ṣoḍaśī, and the renowned Bagalā and Mātaṅgī. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Mother, you are Bhairavī, you are Kamalā; you are Raktadantikā, and your fame is spotless. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: You are Śākambharī, Kauśikī and Bhīmā; you are Mahātamā, the great darkness, the bound of all that moves and all that does not. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You are Candraghaṇṭikā, you are Sāvitrī; you are Mother Gāyatrī, who speaks of Brahman. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: You are Rudrāṇī, you are Kṛṣṇapiṅgalā, dark and tawny; you are the flame of fire, you are Sarvamaṅgalā. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You are Meghasvanā, whose voice is the thunder of clouds, the ascetic and the yoginī; you are thousand-eyed, and you enjoy the whole world, moving and unmoving. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You are Jalodarī, Sarasvatī and Ḍākinī; you are Tridaśeśvarī, queen of the gods, the invincible, and Lākinī. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: You are nourishment, contentment, fortitude and memory, and Śivadūtī; you are Kāmākṣī, modesty and the oblation. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: You are Mahodarī, Kāmākṣī, she who takes away; you are Vināyakī, the Veda and the great Śākinī. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: You are the unborn, she who binds beings in the delusion of action, Brahmāṇī; you are Dhātrī the sustainer, Vārāhī and Śarvāṇī. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: You are the mother of Skanda, riding a lion; Mother Subhadrā, stay favourable to me. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Your names, forms and virtues are boundless; Śeṣa and Sarasvatī have given up describing them. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Mother, the beauty of your body is dark-hued; your name Kālikā is famed in the world. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Your eighteen arms are lovely; in them beautiful weapons shine. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: They hold a conch, a discus and a lovely mace, an iron club, a bhuśuṇḍī and a holy bell. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Taking up the spear, the thunderbolt, the bow and arrows, you struck down and killed all the clans of the demons. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: You slew the demons Śumbha and Niśumbha and drew out the life of Raktabīja. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The sixty-four yoginīs dance with you; you drank wine in the Gaṅgā of battle, its stream of blood. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: At your waist are girdle-bells, and your anklets ring sweetly; hearing them again and again, the race of demons trembles. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: In your hands are the skull-bowl and the fearsome trident, and you are ever the giver of joy to the saints. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Mounted on a corpse, you danced; the mṛdaṅga and the kettledrums sound. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: You drank the blood of the enemy host; whoever did not recognise you gave up his life. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Mother, your tongue lolls and flickers; you give joy to your devotees and sorrow to the wicked. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: A mark of vermilion shines on your forehead; your hair is loose, and your form is most lovely. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The garland of heads at your neck is most splendid; the garland of arms and the bracelets captivate the mind. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Bhavānī, you dance the dance of dissolution; the Vedas have described you, calling you Jagadambā, Mother of the world. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: You dwell in the cremation ground, the terrible one; as one worships you, cut at once the net of worldly existence. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Your fifty-two Śakti Pīṭhas, your sacred seats, are beautiful; there you abide, taking many forms. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: In one place your greatness is that of Vindhyavāsinī; in another your lovely form is that of Kālikā. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Somewhere you became Śākambharī, somewhere Jvālā, and the terrible slayer of Mahiṣāsura. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Kāmākhyā is your lovely name; you fulfil the heart's desires very swiftly. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: In a moment you slew Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa and filled the hearts of the gods with joy. ॥41॥
chalisa.cau42: Mother Tārā, you pervade all; take incarnation to crush the hosts of the enemy. ॥42॥
chalisa.cau43: On hearing your roar, tumult breaks out; your body pervades the whole world, moving and unmoving. ॥43॥
chalisa.cau44: You are of cosmic form, a mine of virtues; great queen, you are the form of the universe. ॥44॥
chalisa.cau45: Creation, preservation and dissolution come about through you; remove the faults of your servant. ॥45॥
chalisa.cau46: Mother Ambā, dwell in my heart; you are ever the support of the humble. ॥46॥
chalisa.cau47: Whoever meditates on you has no fear anywhere. ॥47॥
chalisa.cau48: You are the form of the universe, the primal Bhavānī; the Vedas and the Purāṇas have told your glory. ॥48॥
chalisa.cau49: The power of your name is boundless beyond measure; for one who chants it, not the least fire of sorrow remains. ॥49॥
chalisa.cau50: Victory to Mahākālikā, the benign; victory ever to you, giver of joy to your servants. ॥50॥
chalisa.cau51: Endless generosity is your ornament; be gracious and forgive all my faults. ॥51॥
chalisa.cau52: Knowing me your servant, show me your mercy; regarding me as your son, take me as your own. ॥52॥
chalisa.cau53: Mother, you are the protector of your servants; Mother Kālī, be gracious in every way. ॥53॥
chalisa.cau54: Whoever recites the Chālīsā receives your grace. ॥54॥
chalisa.do3: Victory to Tārā, victory to Dakṣiṇā, Kalāvatī, the root of joy. Your devotee has come to you for refuge; stay ever favourable.
